$extensions.source: tesla.com production CSS + brand manual analysis
$extensions.aesthetic: radical subtraction — full-viewport cinematic photography with near-zero UI chrome

surface.$description: Pure white canvas — Tesla's default page background, a blank gallery wall for photography

surface-dark.$description: True black — cinematic hero sections, vehicle showcase backgrounds, dark full-bleed zones

surface-section.$description: Near-white — subtle section differentiation on light pages, specs/configurator backgrounds

surface-glass.$description: Frosted glass — navigation bar backdrop-filter overlay on scroll

surface-glass-dark.$description: Dark frosted glass — navigation overlay on dark hero imagery

accent.$description: Tesla Blue — the SOLE chromatic color in the entire system. Used only on primary CTA buttons and critical interactive links. Extremely sparingly applied.

accent-hover.$description: Darker blue hover state for primary CTA

text-primary.$description: Near-black with cool blue undertone — all headings and primary text on light surfaces

text-secondary.$description: Medium gray — body copy, descriptive text, secondary information

text-tertiary.$description: Dark gray — sub-navigation links, active menu items

text-muted.$description: Light gray — placeholder text, disabled states, footnotes

text-on-dark.$description: Pure white — text overlaid on dark hero imagery and black sections

text-on-dark-secondary.$description: Muted white — secondary text on dark backgrounds

text-on-accent.$description: White text on the blue CTA button

border.$description: Pale silver — thin dividers, specs table borders, configurator option outlines

border-subtle.$description: Near-invisible border — section separators, ghost button outlines

error.$description: Error red — form validation only, never decorative

success.$description: Success green — order confirmation, availability indicators

warning.$description: Warning state -- standard amber for caution signals

font-display.$value: "Universal Sans Display", "Gotham SSm A", "Gotham SSm B", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font-display.$description: Display/heading font — Tesla switched from Gotham to Universal Sans Display in 2024

font-body.$value: "Universal Sans Text", "Gotham SSm A", "Gotham SSm B", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font-body.$description: Body/UI font — Universal Sans Text for readable running copy

scale-hero.$description: Hero headlines — vehicle names overlaid on full-bleed photography

scale-title.$description: Feature titles — subsection headings, configurator option names

scale-body.$description: Body text — Tesla uses 17px not 16px for body copy

scale-caption.$description: Captions — nav links, footnotes, legal text

line-height-tight.$description: Ultra-tight — hero headlines over photography, near-collapsing for cinematic effect

line-height-body.$description: Body text — readable but not overly generous

weight-light.$description: Light — Tesla's DOMINANT weight. Most headings use 300, creating the airy, premium feel

weight-medium.$description: Medium — CTA buttons, nav links, emphasized text. The HEAVIEST weight Tesla commonly uses

letter-spacing-tight.$description: Negative tracking on hero text — tighter for large display sizes

section-gap.$description: Section gap — Tesla sections are flush edge-to-edge, separated by full-bleed imagery, not whitespace

section-padding-vertical.$description: Vertical breathing room inside each full-viewport section

section-padding-vertical-lg.$description: Hero and feature showcase sections — extreme negative space

content-max-width.$description: Max content width for text blocks — NOT for imagery which goes full-bleed

content-narrow.$description: Narrow content column — centered text blocks under hero imagery

radius-none.$description: No radius — Tesla default. Most elements have sharp edges.

radius-button.$description: Subtle rounding on CTA buttons — barely perceptible

radius-card.$description: Rare card containers — configurator panels, modal dialogs

level-0.$description: Flat — Tesla's DEFAULT. Shadows are almost never used. Depth comes from photography layering and color contrast.

level-1.$description: Whisper — only for sticky nav on scroll, barely perceptible

duration-fade.$description: Content fade-in on scroll, section transitions

duration-page.$description: Page transitions, hero image crossfade, parallax scroll animations

duration-cinematic.$description: Cinematic hero entrance — vehicle reveal, initial page load animation

easing-cinematic.$description: Cinematic ease — aggressive deceleration for reveal animations

parallax-factor.$description: Parallax scroll rate — subtle depth on hero imagery

reduced-duration.$description: Near-zero duration for prefers-reduced-motion. Applied via media query.

reduced-easing.$description: Linear easing for reduced motion -- no spring/bounce.

wide.$description: Wide/4K breakpoint — hero imagery scales to fill viewport
